iomete-spark4:position-deletes:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 writes Parquet position delete files for merge-on-read DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE INTO on V2 tables, and applies position deletes written by other engines.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark4:position-deletes:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 applies position delete files on V3 tables, but writes new merge-on-read deletes on V3 tables as deletion vectors.
caveats: New V3 row-level deletes are written as deletion vectors, not position delete files

iomete-spark4:equality-deletes:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 never writes equality deletes: Spark SQL DML uses copy-on-write or position deletes (deletion vectors on V3).
caveats: Applying equality deletes written by other engines on read does not count as support

iomete-spark4:equality-deletes:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 never writes equality deletes: Spark SQL DML uses copy-on-write or position deletes (deletion vectors on V3).
caveats: Applying equality deletes written by other engines on read does not count as support

iomete-spark4:merge-on-read:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 supports merge-on-read DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE INTO, selected with write.delete.mode, write.update.mode and write.merge.mode, writing position delete files.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark4:merge-on-read:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 supports merge-on-read DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE INTO, selected with write.delete.mode, write.update.mode and write.merge.mode, writing deletion vectors (Puffin files).

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark4:copy-on-write:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 uses copy-on-write by default for DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE INTO, rewriting the affected data files.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark4:copy-on-write:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 uses copy-on-write by default for DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE INTO, rewriting the affected data files.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark4:schema-evolution:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 adds, drops, renames and reorders columns and widens types with ALTER TABLE. MERGE WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION adds source columns during a merge.

links.label: IOMETE Spark 4: MERGE with schema evolution

iomete-spark4:schema-evolution:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 adds, drops, renames and reorders columns and widens types with ALTER TABLE. MERGE WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION adds source columns during a merge.

links.label: IOMETE Spark 4: MERGE with schema evolution

iomete-spark4:type-promotion:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 applies Iceberg's safe type promotions (int to long, float to double, wider decimal precision) with ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE.

iomete-spark4:type-promotion:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 applies Iceberg's safe type promotions (int to long, float to double, wider decimal precision) with ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE.
caveats: The V3 date to timestamp promotion is rejected

iomete-spark4:column-default-values:v2.notes: Column default values are a V3 feature.

iomete-spark4:column-default-values:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 rejects DEFAULT column values on Iceberg tables: CREATE TABLE with a DEFAULT clause fails with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.TABLE_OPERATION, and the connector also refuses ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT.

iomete-spark4:table-creation:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 creates Iceberg tables with CREATE TABLE, CREATE TABLE AS SELECT and REPLACE TABLE AS SELECT, with the format version set in TBLPROPERTIES.

iomete-spark4:table-creation:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 creates Iceberg tables with CREATE TABLE, CREATE TABLE AS SELECT and REPLACE TABLE AS SELECT, with the format version set in TBLPROPERTIES.

iomete-spark4:hidden-partitioning:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 supports Iceberg hidden partitioning with the identity, year, month, day, hour, bucket and truncate transforms.

iomete-spark4:hidden-partitioning:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 supports Iceberg hidden partitioning with the identity, year, month, day, hour, bucket and truncate transforms.

iomete-spark4:partition-evolution:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 evolves partition specs with ALTER TABLE ... ADD, DROP and REPLACE PARTITION FIELD. IOMETE enables the Iceberg SQL extensions by default.

iomete-spark4:partition-evolution:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 evolves partition specs with ALTER TABLE ... ADD, DROP and REPLACE PARTITION FIELD. IOMETE enables the Iceberg SQL extensions by default.

iomete-spark4:multi-arg-transforms:v2.notes: Multi-argument transforms are a V3 feature.

iomete-spark4:multi-arg-transforms:v3.notes: Spark SQL cannot define multi-argument partition transforms, so IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 cannot create them.

iomete-spark4:time-travel:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 supports time travel with VERSION AS OF and TIMESTAMP AS OF in SQL, and reads branches and tags by name.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg branching, tagging and time travel

iomete-spark4:time-travel:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 supports time travel with VERSION AS OF and TIMESTAMP AS OF in SQL, and reads branches and tags by name.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg branching, tagging and time travel

iomete-spark4:table-maintenance:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 runs the Iceberg maintenance procedures: rewrite_data_files, rewrite_manifests, expire_snapshots and remove_orphan_files. IOMETE's Table Maintenance service (Beta) also runs them automatically.

iomete-spark4:table-maintenance:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 runs the Iceberg maintenance procedures: rewrite_data_files, rewrite_manifests, expire_snapshots and remove_orphan_files. IOMETE's Table Maintenance service (Beta) also runs them automatically.

iomete-spark4:branching-tagging:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 creates, replaces and drops branches and tags with the Iceberg SQL extensions, and reads and writes branches.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg branching, tagging and time travel

iomete-spark4:branching-tagging:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 creates, replaces and drops branches and tags with the Iceberg SQL extensions, and reads and writes branches.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg branching, tagging and time travel

iomete-spark4:read-support:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 reads Iceberg V2 tables, applying position deletes.

iomete-spark4:read-support:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 reads Iceberg V3 tables, applying position deletes and deletion vectors.
caveats: GEOMETRY/GEOGRAPHY columns are read from Parquet data files only
V3 tables with a nanosecond timestamp column cannot be read: Spark has no nanosecond type

iomete-spark4:write-insert:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 supports INSERT INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE, DataFrameWriterV2 append and overwrite, CTAS and RTAS.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark4:write-insert:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 supports INSERT INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE, DataFrameWriterV2 append and overwrite, CTAS and RTAS.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE

iomete-spark4:write-merge-update-delete:.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 runs MERGE INTO, UPDATE and DELETE through the Iceberg SQL extensions, in copy-on-write or merge-on-read mode.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE
IOMETE Spark 4: MERGE with schema evolution

iomete-spark4:write-merge-update-delete:.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 runs MERGE INTO, UPDATE and DELETE through the Iceberg SQL extensions, in copy-on-write or merge-on-read mode.

links.label: IOMETE: Iceberg MERGE INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE and DELETE
IOMETE Spark 4: MERGE with schema evolution

iomete-spark4:catalog-integration:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 uses IOMETE's built-in Iceberg REST catalog and connects to external Iceberg REST, and AWS Glue catalogs.
caveats: Nessie catalogs are not supported on IOMETE Spark 4

iomete-spark4:catalog-integration:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 uses IOMETE's built-in Iceberg REST catalog and connects to external Iceberg REST, and AWS Glue catalogs.
caveats: Nessie catalogs are not supported on IOMETE Spark 4

iomete-spark4:statistics:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 writes column metrics (value, null and NaN counts, lower and upper bounds) to manifests by default, and computes Puffin NDV statistics with the compute_table_stats procedure.

iomete-spark4:statistics:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 writes column metrics (value, null and NaN counts, lower and upper bounds) to manifests by default, and computes Puffin NDV statistics with the compute_table_stats procedure.

iomete-spark4:bloom-filters:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 writes Parquet bloom filters for columns enabled with write.parquet.bloom-filter-enabled.column.<name> and uses them to skip row groups.
caveats: Opt-in per column

iomete-spark4:bloom-filters:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 writes Parquet bloom filters for columns enabled with write.parquet.bloom-filter-enabled.column.<name> and uses them to skip row groups.
caveats: Opt-in per column

iomete-spark4:aws-glue-catalog:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 connects to the AWS Glue Data Catalog as an external Iceberg catalog.
caveats: Not measured on IOMETE: the suite's Glue test skips outside AWS

iomete-spark4:aws-glue-catalog:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 connects to the AWS Glue Data Catalog as an external Iceberg catalog.
caveats: Not measured on IOMETE: the suite's Glue test skips outside AWS

iomete-spark4:rest-catalog:v2.notes: IOMETE's managed catalog is an Iceberg REST catalog, and IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 also connects to external Iceberg REST catalogs.

iomete-spark4:rest-catalog:v3.notes: IOMETE's managed catalog is an Iceberg REST catalog, and IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 also connects to external Iceberg REST catalogs.

iomete-spark4:unity-catalog:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 connects to Unity Catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Not measured against Unity Catalog

iomete-spark4:unity-catalog:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 connects to Unity Catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Not measured against Unity Catalog

iomete-spark4:snowflake-horizon-catalog:.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 connects to Snowflake Horizon Catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Not measured against Snowflake Horizon Catalog

iomete-spark4:snowflake-horizon-catalog:.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 connects to Snowflake Horizon Catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Not measured against Snowflake Horizon Catalog
V3 table support depends on what Snowflake Horizon Catalog accepts

iomete-spark4:google-lakehouse:v2.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 can reach Google's Lakehouse runtime catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Inferred from generic REST catalog support; not measured against Google Lakehouse

iomete-spark4:google-lakehouse:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 can reach Google's Lakehouse runtime catalog through its Iceberg REST endpoint, configured as an external REST catalog.
caveats: Inferred from generic REST catalog support; not measured against Google Lakehouse

iomete-spark4:variant-type:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 creates, writes and reads VARIANT columns on V3 tables (parse_json, variant_get).

iomete-spark4:shredded-variant:v2.notes: Shredded VARIANT is a V3 feature.

iomete-spark4:shredded-variant:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 writes shredded VARIANT columns (typed_value sub-columns) to Parquet when the write.parquet.shred-variants table property is true, and reads them back.
caveats: Off by default: enable with the write.parquet.shred-variants table property or the spark.sql.iceberg.shred-variants session conf
Measured 2026-11-26 on IOMETE Spark 4.2.1-v1 (Iceberg 1.12.0) against IOMETE's Iceberg REST catalog: the Parquet footer has typed_value columns with write.parquet.shred-variants=true

links.label: apache/iceberg#14297: writing shredded variant from Spark

iomete-spark4:geometry-type:v2.notes: GEOMETRY and GEOGRAPHY are V3 types.

iomete-spark4:geometry-type:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 maps Spark GEOMETRY and GEOGRAPHY to the Iceberg V3 types and reads and writes them in Parquet data files.
caveats: Parquet data files only
Only CRSs that Spark recognizes; GEOGRAPHY supports OGC:CRS84 with spherical edges only
Columns with mixed SRIDs cannot be written
Vectorized reads fall back to row-based reads

links.label: apache/iceberg#17073: Spark geo values in Parquet

iomete-spark4:nanosecond-timestamps:v2.notes: Nanosecond timestamps are a V3 type.

iomete-spark4:nanosecond-timestamps:v3.notes: Spark has no nanosecond timestamp type, so IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 cannot create or read TIMESTAMP_NS columns.

iomete-spark4:unknown-type:v2.notes: The unknown type is a V3 type.

iomete-spark4:unknown-type:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 maps Spark's VOID (NullType) columns to the Iceberg V3 unknown type.

iomete-spark4:lineage:v2.notes: Row lineage is a V3 feature.

iomete-spark4:lineage:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 assigns V3 row lineage and exposes the _row_id and _last_updated_sequence_number metadata columns on V3 tables.

iomete-spark4:deletion-vectors:v2.notes: Deletion vectors are a V3 feature.

iomete-spark4:deletion-vectors:v3.notes: IOMETE Spark 4.2.1 writes V3 binary deletion vectors (Puffin files) for merge-on-read DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE INTO, and applies them on read. IOMETE Spark 3.5.9-v1 reads the deletes correctly.
caveats: Measured 2026-11-26 on IOMETE Spark 4.2.1-v1 (Iceberg 1.12.0) against IOMETE's Iceberg REST catalog; cross-version reads checked for DELETE
